name: master-office-addin
description: Master: asisten perintah untuk Microsoft Word dan Excel (AI Claude saat online, mesin perintah lokal saat offline)

scripts.register: office-addin-dev-settings register manifest-excel.xml && office-addin-dev-settings register manifest-word.xml
scripts.unregister: office-addin-dev-settings unregister manifest-excel.xml && office-addin-dev-settings unregister manifest-word.xml
scripts.validate: office-addin-manifest validate manifest-excel.xml && office-addin-manifest validate manifest-word.xml
